observations: Three photos show stacks of used car tires in a shop or storage area with tiled flooring.
Tires vary in tread depth and condition; some show significant wear, others appear more worn.
Photo 2 shows a stack of tires with visible tread patterns and sidewall markings; one tire has 'VOLVO' embossed on the sidewall.
Tires are stacked vertically, some with visible red or blue markings on the sidewall (possibly indicating different types or brands).
No visible brand or model markings are readable on any tire in any photo.
The seller claims 'Belgium tires and rim', but no brand or country of origin is visible on the tires.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JI IKWE ANTHONY' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: No brand or country of origin is visible on any tire in the photos. The claim cannot be verified from the images.

risks.risk: Tires may be damaged, cracked, or have hidden defects not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of each tire's sidewall, tread, and inner rim for cracks, bulges, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unsafe or unusable, with reduced value.

risks.risk: Tires may be expired or have low tread life, affecting safety and resale value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the DOT code on the sidewall (e.g., 5-digit week and year) to verify age.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown age, which may reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: Tires may be mismatched or incompatible with the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: Photo showing the size and model of each tire, or a list of all tires with their specifications.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially incompatible, reducing value.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the DOT code on the sidewall of each tire to verify age.
Photos showing the size and model of each tire, or a list of all tires with their specifications.
Close-up shots of the tread, sidewall, and inner rim for damage or defects.
Photos of any red or blue markings on the sidewall to identify different types or brands.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
